DDNSS_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: DDNSS_POLLING_INTERVAL
DDNSS_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 2)

DDNSS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: DDNSS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
DDNSS_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 60)

DDNSS_SEQUENCE_INTERVAL.title: DDNSS_SEQUENCE_INTERVAL
DDNSS_SEQUENCE_INTERVAL.description: Time between sequential requests in seconds (Default: 60)

DDNSS_TTL.title: DDNSS_TTL
DDNSS_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 120)
